searchSub: Search current knowledge in your authorized spaces.
searchWait: Search is waiting for a Web API.
searchWhy: The server currently provides MCP tools but no authorized Web search endpoint. Your query stays in the address bar so you can return to it.
searchStart: Enter a query to search your knowledge.
searchStartWhy: Results will become available after the authorized Web search API is connected.
noSampleResults: No sample records match this query.
changeSearch: Try another query or adjust the filters.
previewSearchHint: Enter a query or choose a filter to inspect sample records.
dialogSearchDescription: Find context and documents across your spaces, and read them here.
dialogStartWhy: Try a project name, a decision, or a working preference. Choose a space to narrow your search.
dialogNoResultsWhy: Try a shorter query, all types, or all spaces. Recently saved knowledge may still be waiting to be indexed.
dialogSelectWhy: Choose a result to read the full context or Markdown document.
dialogSearchErrorWhy: Your query and filters are kept.
dialogPreviewErrorWhy: This item may have been removed or may be inaccessible. Try again or choose another result.
dialogDegraded: Semantic search is unavailable. These results use keyword search.
dialogLimit: Up to 50 matching records. Narrow the results with keywords or a space.
dialogCopyError: Could not copy. Please try again.
dialogWorkspaceErrorWhy: You can still search all spaces. Retry to choose a specific space.
